en.coverSub: Finished actions at a stated time: the ground you have already crossed.
en.actSpeakBrief: In pairs, three minutes each. Past simple only: every verb finished, every event tied to a time.
en.actSpeak1: Tell your partner about the last journey you made: where you went, how you got there, and what went wrong. Anchor every event to a time.
en.actSpeak2: Interview your partner about a job or a school they left. When did it start, what did they do there, and why did it end?
en.actSpeak3: Describe a day that changed your plans. Sequence it: first, then, after that, in the end.
en.actWriteBrief: 150–200 words: a message to a friend about a weekend that did not go to plan. At least six past simple verbs, two of them irregular, and every event tied to a time.
en.actPlaceholder: Last Saturday we left the house at seven and…
